LEAID=1708730 | Cary CCSD 26, ILLINOIS | Targeted Retry
============================================================
I need to review the evidence from my previous search to apply the transition rule correctly.

Based on my previous findings:

- **Brandon White** was the superintendent and departed in July 2025 (before the school year started)
- **Dr. Jennifer Thomas** became Interim Superintendent starting in August 2025 (the beginning of the 2025-26 school year)
- **Dr. Sarah Cacciatore** was selected in February 2026 to start July 1, 2026 (after the 2025-26 school year ends)

**Applying the Transition Rule:**
The transition from Thomas to Cacciatore occurred in February 2026 (January 2026 or later). According to the rule, when a transition occurs in January 2026 or later, I should report the **EARLIER superintendent** because they served the majority of the year.

Dr. Jennifer Thomas served from August 2025 through at least March 6, 2026 (current date), which is approximately 7+ months of the 10-month school year (August 2025 – June 2026). This constitutes the majority of the school year.

Based on the search results, I found critical information: **Michele Schmidt became the District Administrator (superintendent equivalent) of Bristol #1 School District in Wisconsin on July 1, 2025.** [10] She serves as the permanent leader for the 2025–2026 school year, having been hired through the superintendent search process that concluded in spring 2025.

## Leadership Timeline for 2025–2026

Jack Musha served as District Administrator until December 31, 2024, when he resigned following an investigation. [4][3] The Bristol School Board stated they expected "Jim Feil to continue as our Interim District Administrator until a permanent administrator is selected," and after the New Year announced a rigorous selection process. [4] 

Michele Schmidt was formally hired and began her role as District Administrator on July 1, 2025, transitioning from her previous position at Hartland-Lakeside School District, where she had served since 2006 in roles including Principal and Director of Special Education. [10] Since she started on July 1, 2025, she has served the entire 2025–2026 school year (August 2025 – June 2026).

## Title Designation

The district uses "District Administrator" as the equivalent title to superintendent, which is standard in Wisconsin single-school districts. [10][2]

- **John S. Caverly, M.Ed.** as **Superintendent of Schools** [1]

However, the **Staff directory** lists [2]:

- **Heidi Early-Hersey** as **Interim Superintendent of Schools & District Curriculum Director** [2]

Since the Staff directory is the more current page (showing the live staff listing), and Heidi Early-Hersey is explicitly titled "Interim Superintendent," this indicates a transition in leadership. Heidi Early-Hersey has served in the interim superintendent role and continues to serve in that capacity for the 2025–2026 school year [2].

The superintendent's office page appears to contain outdated information with John S. Caverly's listing, but the current staff directory—which would be the active operational record—identifies Heidi Early-Hersey as the Interim Superintendent.

Based on my comprehensive search of current sources, I have found important and conflicting information about RSU 35/MSAD 35's superintendent:

## Key Findings

**The district's official website shows conflicting information:**

The Superintendent's Office page [4] lists **John S. Caverly, M.Ed.** as "Superintendent of Schools," while the Staff directory [7] lists **Heidi Early-Hersey** as "Interim Superintendent of Schools & District Curriculum Director."

**Critically important:** A job posting dated January 8, 2026 [2] (from the current school year) shows that **the superintendent position is vacant**. The posting states: "Posting open until March 15, 2026" with a "Start date is July 1, 2026." This indicates the position will be filled in July 2026—*after* the 2025–26 school year ends.

**The Maine Department of Education's 2025–26 Special Education Directory ** lists "Scott Reuning" for RSU 35/MSAD 35, but this entry appears to reference the "Director of Special Services" (Scott Reuning is listed as Director of Special Services on the district website [4]), not the superintendent.

## Critical Assessment

As of March 2026, RSU 35/MSAD 35 appears to be operating under **interim leadership**. The district website lists Heidi Early-Hersey as "Interim Superintendent," and an active superintendent search is underway (posting open through March 15, 2026) with a new superintendent expected to start July 1, 2026. The fact that John S. Caverly is still listed on the Superintendent's Office page suggests he may have left or transitioned out of the position, and Early-Hersey is serving in the interim capacity during the transition and search process.

[1] The job listing shows the position was open with a start date of July 1, 2026, meaning no permanent superintendent would take office before the 2025–26 school year ends in June 2026. [1]

However, a school board meeting from February 16, 2026 (just held) references "Pete" as the superintendent report presenter.  Peter Hopka was mentioned in a Village of Solon Springs meeting minutes from June 2025 as "Superintendent of Solon Springs School District."  Historical records show Mike Cox held the superintendent position at some point. 

Given the vacancy posting with interviews scheduled for late February and early March 2026, and references to "Pete/Peter" providing superintendent reports in mid-February, **Peter Hopka appears to be serving as superintendent (likely interim) during this transition period for the majority of the 2025–2026 school year**, even though a permanent replacement search was underway.

LEAID=0604200 | Bayshore Elementary, CALIFORNIA | Targeted Retry
============================================================
I have found conflicting information on the district's official website itself. The Contact Info page lists Elizabeth Veal as Superintendent (current), while the "Our Superintendent" page announces Bhavna Narula as appointed superintendent with a start date of July 1, 2025. 

Given that today is March 6, 2026—well into the 2025–26 school year—and Narula's appointment began July 1, 2025 (which is in the August 2025 – June 2026 school year window and before January 2026), the transition occurred in the early portion of the school year. According to the **transition rule**: when a transition occurred between August and December 2025, the NEW superintendent should be reported, as they will serve the majority of the year.

Bhavna Narula began July 1, 2025, meaning she has served from the official start of the 2025–26 school year (August 2025) through March 2026—eight months of the ten-month school year. She clearly serves the majority.

LEAID=0620700 | Lakeside Joint, CALIFORNIA | Targeted Retry
============================================================
Based on my review of the district's official website and supporting sources, I can now provide the corrected superintendent information with proper transition analysis.

The search results show a critical distinction: **The search results contain information about Lakeside Union School District (LUSD)—a different, larger district—NOT Lakeside Joint School District (LJSD).** Results 3, 6 show LUSD superintendent searches; this is a separate district in San Diego County with multiple schools. The correct district is **Lakeside Joint School District** in Los Gatos, CA (Santa Clara/Santa Cruz County, 1 school).

For **Lakeside Joint School District** (Los Gatos, NCES LEAID 0620700):

- **Previous superintendent:** Sean Joyce (served through school year 2024–25 or into 2025) [5][8][10]
- **Job posting:** February 26, 2025, for a Superintendent/Principal position beginning July 1, 2025 
- **Current superintendent:** Steve Burrell, Superintendent/Principal, introduced in his "new" welcome message on the district website [7] and confirmed in the California Department of Education directory (dated July 22, 2025) [4][1]

**Transition timing:** The position was posted in February 2025 for a July 1, 2025 start. Steve Burrell's presence in the July 2025 CDE directory and his introduction as "new" on the district website indicates he began in July 2025—during the school year but in the first two months (Aug–Dec 2025 window). Per the transition rule, since the transition occurred in July/August 2025 (within the Aug–Dec 2025 window), the **new superintendent (Steve Burrell) serves the majority** of the 2025–26 school year (July/Aug 2025 through June 2026 = ~11 months of a 10-month school year).

Based on my research of Owosso Public Schools' official website and related sources, I cannot identify a superintendent currently serving the district for the 2025–2026 school year.

## Key Findings

The district's official Administrative Team page [1] lists only Dr. Catheryn Dwyer as "Assistant Superintendent of Curriculum and Instruction"—not as superintendent. No superintendent position is listed on the district website.

Historical context reveals that Andrea Tuttle served as Superintendent of Owosso Public Schools from 2010 until December 2023, when she was selected as superintendent of Grosse Pointe Public School System [3]. Board meeting minutes from early 2024 document that Owosso Public Schools initiated a superintendent search and hired an interim superintendent (David E. Schulte from RESD) following Tuttle's departure .

Board minutes from June 2024 reference "Superintendent Brooks" at a budget hearing , suggesting another individual was appointed. However, recent district website pages (dated 2024–2025) continue to show only Dr. Catheryn Dwyer in the administrative structure with no superintendent listed.

I apologize for the confusion. Let me clarify: The district you're asking about is Turner-Kansas City (NCES LEAID 2012360) in KANSAS, and you've provided that its official website is http://www.turnerusd202.org. 

Turner USD 202 *is* the Turner-Kansas City district in Kansas—the names refer to the same entity. "Turner-Kansas City" is the geographic descriptor used in NCES data, while "Turner USD 202" (Unified School District 202) is the official legal name of the district. Both identify the same school district located at 800 S 55th Street, Kansas City, Kansas.

My previous answer correctly identified Dr. Jason Dandoy as the superintendent of this district for the 2025–2026 school year, based on the official district website and corroborating sources. There is no separate "Turner-Kansas City" district distinct from Turner USD 202.

## Superintendent Information

## Transition Context

Jose Miguel Kubes, the previous superintendent, quietly stepped down in April 2025 after serving in the position for nearly three years. [3] Kubes had joined the district in 2020 and was promoted to superintendent in 2022. His departure in April 2025 means he served only the first part of the 2025–26 school year (August–April, approximately 9 months), while Eric Griffin, as interim superintendent since his departure, has been serving the remainder of the school year through June 2026. Under the transition rule, because Griffin has served and will serve the majority of the school year from April 2025 onward, he is correctly identified as the superintendent for 2025–26.

LEAID=4004500 | BIXBY, OKLAHOMA | Targeted Retry
============================================================
Based on the district website announcement, Lydia Wilson's appointment became effective July 1, 2025. This transition occurred before August 2025 (the start of the 2025–26 school year). According to the transition rule: if the transition was Aug–Dec 2025, report the NEW superintendent; if Jan 2026 or later, report the EARLIER superintendent.

Since the transition occurred in July 2025 (before the school year started on August 2025), Lydia Wilson has served as the designated superintendent from the beginning of the 2025–26 school year and will continue through June 2026, making her the superintendent for the entire majority of the school year.

============================================================
Based on my research, Saco H S is a very small one-school district in Valley County, Montana. The district's official website at sacoschools.k12.mt.us was not accessible. However, according to Montana state law and practice, very small elementary and high school districts in Montana often do not have their own superintendent. Instead, they are served by the **County Superintendent of Schools**.

For Saco H S (located in Valley County, Montana), the County Superintendent is [Marie Pippin](web:3), who serves as both Clerk & Recorder and Superintendent of Schools for Valley County [3][6]. This is the standard arrangement for small Montana school districts like Saco H S.

[7] An older Iowa Department of Education District Directory (from a prior year) also lists Eric Trager as superintendent.  Additionally, the 2022-23 Heartland AEA Directory lists Eric Trager. [5]

The key evidence points to a superintendent transition: **Trevor Miller became superintendent in 2024**, replacing Eric Trager. The district's official website and the current (2025-26) state directory both confirm Trevor Miller's appointment effective 2024.
